title: Epsom College Lancaster Memorial
location_name: Chapel of St Luke, Epsom College, Surrey
crew_summary: Crew — details not recorded in source
memorial_details: Wall-mounted stone tablet to F/L D.L. Venning DFC BA inside the Chapel of St Luke, Epsom College, Surrey.
narrative: Lancaster PB921 of 635 Squadron (Pathfinder Force), coded F2-N, departed Downham Market at 1721 on 5 March 1945 for Chemnitz. Flight Lieutenant D.L. Venning DFC BA, a Pathfinder pilot who held both the Distinguished Flying Cross and a Bachelor of Arts degree, is commemorated in the Chapel of St Luke at Epsom College.
